correctness.rationale: The two-atom moment inversion is complete across the nonregular and regular strata. For positive degree variance, the first three star moments recover the unordered block sizes and block degrees; P4 then recovers the cross density and hence the diagonal densities. On the regular stratum, the triangle recovers the unique real cube-root parameter and the diamond recovers the block-size product unless the graphon is constant. Boundary edge probabilities do not break these polynomial identities.
